verdict.rationale: Segment's Public API reference at docs.segmentapis.com is described as an interactive reference with 'Create a test request' and 'Install and use an SDK' sections. It also offers a downloadable OpenAPI spec and documents authentication, rate limits, pagination and versioning, which together deliver an interactive, runnable API reference. Missing for 10: detail on how the in-browser request console executes calls and what it returns, interactive coverage of the other APIs (e.g. Profile API), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
